### Soil Bioengineering in Tropical Regions {.card-title}

**Fundamentals, Techniques and Applications**

Technical-scientific manual with 21 chapters organized in 4 parts, ranging from soil formation fundamentals and erosion to stabilization techniques with living materials, innovations in geotextiles and superabsorbent biopolymers. Includes sizing equations, comparative tables and case studies. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 License.

[{{< fa book-open >}} Access the ebook](../books/bioengenharia-solos/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}

### Landscape Science {.card-title}

**Fundamentals, Analysis Methods and Territorial Planning**

Textbook with 21 chapters organized in 4 parts, covering landscape ecology fundamentals and spatial metrics to remote sensing, GIS, land use dynamics, ecosystem services, ecological restoration and scenario modeling for sustainable management of tropical landscapes. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 License.

[{{< fa book-open >}} Access the ebook](../books/ciencia-paisagem/){.btn .btn-success .btn-sm}

### Intellectual Property and Innovation in Agribusiness {.card-title}

**Fundamentals, Protection and Technology Transfer**

Textbook with 11 chapters organized in 4 parts, covering innovation management, intangible asset protection (patents, plant varieties, geographical indications), IP valuation, technology transfer, agricultural technology entrepreneurship, academic spin-offs and IP in digital agriculture. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 License.
